slides.heading: What it is
paras: Boris Cherny — creator of Claude Code — runs 3 to 15 Claude Code sessions in parallel, each in its own git worktree.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: GitHub data: gh pr list --state merged --author @me for baseline and trial windows gives merged PRs per day and median cycle time computed…
Two dev servers from different worktrees both return HTTP 200 when curled at the same moment on their assigned ports.

GitHub data: gh pr list --state merged --author @me for baseline and trial windows gives merged PRs per day and median cycle time computed… Two dev servers from different worktrees both return HTTP 200 when curled at the same moment on their assigned ports.

slides.heading: Port collisions
paras: second dev server fails with EADDRINUSE or silently serves the other worktree.
hash-derived ports checked with ss -ltn, and remove hard-coded ports from source.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 7 of 8. Biggest failure mode. Port collisions. Tell: second dev server fails with EADDRINUSE or silently serves the other worktree. Fix: hash-derived ports checked with ss -ltn, and remove hard-coded ports from source.
